| 3 | [Multi-trait models](../reports/03_multitrait_gxe_FULL_rg1.00_MT.html), [GxE control data](../reports/03_multitrait_gxe_FULL_rg1.00_GxE.html), [GxE data](../reports/03_multitrait_gxe_FULL_rg0.90_GxE.html) |
| 4 | Breeding programmes: [phenotypic](../reports/04_breeding_program_sim_FULL_rg1.00_PHENO.html), [NTM](../reports/04_breeding_program_sim_FULL_rg1.00_GS_NTM.html), [NUE 0.35](../reports/04_breeding_program_sim_FULL_rg1.00_GS_NTM_NUE35.html), [NUE 0.75](../reports/04_breeding_program_sim_FULL_rg1.00_GS_NTM_NUE75.html), [milk urea](../reports/04_breeding_program_sim_FULL_rg1.00_GS_NTM_NUE35_MUN.html), [methane](../reports/04_breeding_program_sim_FULL_rg1.00_CH4_KNEE.html), [optimum contribution](../reports/04_breeding_program_sim_FULL_rg1.00_GS_NTM_NUE35_OCS_dF1.html), [mate allocation](../reports/04_breeding_program_sim_FULL_rg1.00_GS_NTM_NUE35_MATE.html) |
